capabilities.notes: Qoder CLI stream-json over stdio (--print --input-format stream-json). Steering and follow-ups send priority next/later user messages; cancellation uses the interrupt control request plus process termination; permission prompts are surfaced as awaiting_input and answered through the can_use_tool control protocol; resume uses --resume <session-id> and verifies the returned session id. Qoder sessions live in the user's Qoder config directory. There is no sandbox: cwd is not a file-isolation boundary. Protocol support is covered by a scripted CLI and a real no-login failure probe; a completed real-model worker/steer/cancel/resume run is not yet validated.
